controls.name: Account Management
controls.remediation: Remove unused accounts. Restrict OpenClaw allowlist to named users only.

controls.name: Access Enforcement
controls.remediation: Set workspaceOnly=true. Set sandbox mode to all. Restrict sudoers. Disable browser noSandbox. Set hooks.allowRequestSessionKey=false.

controls.name: Least Privilege
controls.remediation: Disable elevated exec unless required. Confirm service account has no unnecessary group memberships. Set agents.defaults.subagents.allowChildOverrides=false. Disable gateway terminal.

controls.name: Remote Access
controls.remediation: Set gateway.bind to loopback. Enable gateway.auth.mode=token. Set auth rateLimit. Disable external hooks and gateway terminal.

controls.name: Event Logging
controls.remediation: Enable auditd. Set OpenClaw logging level to info or higher.

controls.name: Content of Audit Records
controls.remediation: Ensure audit records include timestamp, user, action, and outcome.

controls.name: Protection of Audit Information
controls.remediation: Audit logs must be owned by root, mode 600. Restrict write access.

controls.name: Audit Record Generation
controls.remediation: Add auditd watch rules for ~/.openclaw/secrets/ and OpenClaw config files. Review transcripts.autoStart sources.

controls.name: Audit Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.remediation: Review security.audit.suppressions entries. Every suppression must be justified and periodically reviewed. Unreviewed suppressions create blind spots.

controls.name: Baseline Configuration
controls.remediation: Maintain openclaw.json.baseline as the documented configuration baseline.

controls.name: Configuration Settings
controls.remediation: Apply all settings in openclaw.json.baseline. Apply all Sarge hardening scripts. Verify models.mode, session.dmScope, and cron settings match baseline.

controls.name: Least Functionality
controls.remediation: Disable unused OpenClaw plugins, skills, and tools. Set skills.workshop.approvalPolicy=review. Disable browser unless needed. Set discovery.mdns.mode=minimal. Remove unnecessary OS packages.

controls.name: Identification and Authentication (Org Users)
controls.remediation: Enable PAM faillock. Restrict OpenClaw to authenticated Discord/channel users only.

controls.name: Authenticator Management
controls.remediation: Set pwquality minlen=12, complexity rules. Set PASS_MAX_DAYS=90, PASS_MIN_DAYS=1.

controls.name: Authentication Feedback
controls.remediation: Ensure login failure messages do not reveal whether username or password was wrong.

controls.name: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.remediation: Enable TLS on gateway. Use Cloudflare Tunnel (TLS enforced) for all remote access.

controls.name: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.remediation: Secrets directory must be 700. All secret files must be 600. Owner must be service account only.

controls.name: Flaw Remediation
controls.remediation: Enable unattended-upgrades for security patches. Review and apply pending updates.

controls.name: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.remediation: Set session.dmScope to per-channel-peer. Review tools.web settings. Disable diagnostics.otel.captureContent unless the collector is within your data boundary.

controls.name: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.remediation: Configure gateway.auth.rateLimit with maxAttempts=10, windowMs=60000, lockoutMs=300000. Configure PAM faillock.

controls.name: Session Termination
controls.remediation: Set mcp.sessionIdleTtlMs to 600000 (10 min). Set subagents.archiveAfterMinutes to 60. Review cron.sessionRetention.

controls.name: Configuration Change Control
controls.remediation: Set gateway.reload.mode to hybrid. Disable update.auto unless stableDelayHours >= 6. Review restart command availability.

controls.name: Access Restrictions for Change
controls.remediation: Set skills.workshop.approvalPolicy to review. Disable allowUploadedArchives and allowSymlinkTargetWrites. Review plugin entries for hooks.allowPromptInjection.

controls.name: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.remediation: Set per-model rate limits. Bound maxConcurrent to 4 for agents, 8 for subagents. Set cron.maxConcurrentRuns to 8.

controls.name: Boundary Protection
controls.remediation: Set browser.ssrfPolicy.dangerouslyAllowPrivateNetwork=false. Set discovery.mdns.mode=minimal. Disable external hooks unless required.

controls.name: Information System Monitoring
controls.remediation: Enable diagnostics, audit, and cron.failureAlert. Enable auditd on the host. Review security.audit.suppressions for blind spots.

controls.name: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.remediation: If rescue mode is enabled, restrict to ownerDmOnly=true. Set pendingTtlMinutes to a short window (5 min default) to prevent stale rescue state.

controls.name: Continuous Monitoring
controls.remediation: Enable security.installPolicy. Review audit suppressions. Enable diagnostics.

controls.name: Fail-Safe Procedures
controls.remediation: Bound cron retry.maxAttempts. If crestodian rescue is enabled, set short pendingTtlMinutes.

controls.name: Information Management and Retention
controls.remediation: Set compaction.mode to safeguard. Enable memoryFlush and truncateAfterCompaction. Review transcripts.maxUtterances and media.ttlHours retention bounds. Review compaction thresholds on CM-2 baseline cadence.

controls.name: Malicious Code Protection
controls.remediation: Install and configure ClamAV or equivalent. Schedule regular scans.
